en-US.title: Kairos: Her Seasons
en-US.subtitle: One small idea a day, for her
en-US.description:
Kairos turns her cycle into four seasons and gives you one small, specific thing to do each day, so you are there before she has to ask.

WORKS WITH ANY PERIOD APP
She keeps using the tracker she already has. A screenshot of her calendar is enough: Kairos reads it on your iPhone, in a couple of seconds, and nothing is uploaded. No screenshot? Pick the day her last period started and you are done.

ONE IDEA A DAY
Not a list of tips. One idea, timed to where she is: a quiet night in when her energy is low, something new when it is rising, a heads-up before the tender days. Tap Done, ask for another, or skip it. Kairos learns what lands.

HER SEASONS AT A GLANCE
Winter, spring, summer, autumn. A single orb shows today, and a ribbon of colour shows the next three weeks. No charts to study.

NEVER ONLY THEN
Big gestures are spread across her whole month, on purpose. Care that only shows up on certain days stops feeling like care.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. Her dates stay on your phone and are not sent to us or anyone else. Notifications say nothing revealing on a lock screen.

TRYING FOR A BABY
Switch it on and Kairos shows her most likely fertile days, helps you keep those evenings free, and stays kind through the wait.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Kairos estimates dates from her past periods. Every body varies, and estimates can be off by days.
- Kairos is not a contraceptive and is not a medical device. Do not use it to prevent pregnancy, and talk to a doctor about any health concern.
- It works best when she is in on it: ask her for the screenshot.
en-US.promoText: One small idea a day, timed to her cycle. Works from a screenshot of any period app. No account, nothing uploaded.

review.notes: No account or sign-in is needed. On the first screen, tap "See a demo" for a fully populated example (a simulated couple). To test setup: tap "I'm her partner", then "Pick a date" and choose any past day; or "Her screenshot" and choose a screenshot of any period-tracking app's month calendar. The screenshot is analysed on the device and is not uploaded. This edition of the app sends no data to any server; a few ideas offer a button that opens Maps or Messages. Cycle estimates are informational only; the app makes no contraceptive or medical claims.
